plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's identity. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper press against your sense of self, confidence, and direction. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: The harder part is when friction becomes the main way the relationship gets attention. If the two of you only feel connected when something is tense, the relationship can start running on conflict instead of care. What began as chemistry can turn into a habit of poking at each other and calling it passion.
advice: Not every reaction needs a response. Not every little thing has to become a whole thing.
